name: Poison Tip
description:
Once per day, you may apply poison to the tips of projectiles for one of your ranged weapons. Roll Craft to set the Difficulty.

For the next day, whenever you hit a creature with a poisoned projectile, the creature rolls Fortitude against the Difficulty. On a win, the creature takes -1 Defense, and at the beginning of each of its turns, it must repeat the roll. On each win, it takes an additional -1 Defense. On a loss, the effect ends.

Describe how you apply the poison.
successes:
✨: Each time the creature takes -1 Defense, it also takes 1d4 damage.

🌞: Each time the creature takes -1 Defense, it also rolls Injury.
